rounds.oldMeaning: Kudala yayithetha umntu ofundisayo okanye okhokela abafundayo.
rounds.story: Igama lisuka ekufundiseni. Ngokwanda kobuKristu laqala ukusetyenziswa kakhulu kumkhokeli wenkonzo.

rounds.oldMeaning: Kwakuqala lithetha indibano yabantu, ibhunga okanye isihlwele esihlanganileyo.
rounds.story: Xa iicawa zasasazeka, ibandla laqala ukugxila ngakumbi kubantu abahlanganela unqulo.

rounds.oldMeaning: Kudala wawusisibizo sempi, ibutho okanye uhambo lokulwa.
rounds.story: Ukudibana kwabantu ngezithethe, urhulumente neenkonzo kwenza igama lisuke emkhosini lisondele nakwimisitho.

rounds.oldMeaning: Kwakudla ngokubhekisa ngakumbi kumyalezo obhaliweyo, njengencwadi ethunyelwayo.
rounds.story: Ukusabalala kokubhala nokushicilela kwandise eli gama, de lasetyenziswa kakhulu nakwiincwadi zokufunda.

rounds.oldMeaning: Kudala wayesaziwa ngakumbi njengexhwele okanye igqirha lesintu.
rounds.story: Ngokufika kwezibhedlele nezonyango zale mihla, igama laqalisa nokubhekisa kugqirha ofunde ezonyango.

rounds.oldMeaning: Ekuqaleni yayibhekisa kwimotor okanye injini ngokubanzi, hayi emotweni yabantu kuphela.
rounds.story: Njengoko iimoto zabakhweli zanda ezindleleni, abantu baqala ukulisebenzisa kakhulu kule nto kanye.

rounds.oldMeaning: Kudala sasithetha inqanaba, udidi okanye isidima somntu.
rounds.story: Imfundo ephezulu yenze igama lagxila kakhulu kwisidanga somfundi ophumeleleyo.

rounds.oldMeaning: Yayisithiwa kuye nawuphi na umntu ongamele okanye olawula intlanganiso nomsebenzi.
rounds.story: Kwinkqubo yezopolitiko yale mihla, eli gama lagxila kakhulu kumntu okhokela ilizwe.

rounds.oldMeaning: Ekuqaleni yayisisixhobo esisendlini okanye eofisini, esidityaniswe ngocingo.
rounds.story: Xa iminxeba ephathwayo yasasazeka, abantu baqala ukuliva kuqala njengento ephathwa esandleni.
Isixhobo sekhompyutha sabizwa njalo kuba sincinane yaye sasinomsila ofana nowesilwanyana.

rounds.oldMeaning: Yayingumngxuma odongeni, onokuvulwa ukuze kungene ukukhanya nomoya.
rounds.story: Xa iikhompyutha zafika, igama lathathwa laya kwisahlulo sesikrini esivuleka size sivale.

rounds.oldMeaning: Kudala yayileliphepha elinye lencwadi okanye lephephandaba.
rounds.story: Ulwimi lwesikrini lwandise intsingiselo yalo, ukusuka kwiphepha eliprintiweyo ukuya kwelibonakala kwiintanethi.
